bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to environment; requiring a report on fluoropolymers used in consumer products.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. FLUOROPOLYMERS IN CONSUMER PRODUCTS; REPORT.

(a) By February 15, 2028, the commissioner of the Pollution Control Agency must submit a report to the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees with jurisdiction over environment and natural resources that includes an assessment of:

(1) the statutory and regulatory authority, administrative infrastructure, research capabilities, and funding necessary to develop and implement a program for reviewing fluoropolymers used in consumer products and their potential threat to human health and the environment;

(2) available scientific data regarding fluoropolymers;

(3) other state and federal statutory and regulatory actions taken regarding fluoropolymers; and

(4) potential critical uses of fluoropolymers and their relation to the supply chain.

(b) For purposes of this section, "fluoropolymers" means fluorinated polymers consisting of polymeric substances for which the backbone of the polymer is either a perfluorinated or polyfluorinated carbon-only backbone or a perfluorinated polyether.

(4) potential critical uses of fluoropolymers and their relation to the supply chain.

(b) For purposes of this section, "fluoropolymers" means fluorinated polymers consisting of polymeric substances for which the backbone of the polymer is either a perfluorinated or polyfluorinated carbon-only backbone or a perfluorinated polyether.
